# Draft:Alex Stewart International

----
Alex Stewart International  is a private inspection company based in the United Kingdom that provides surveying services worldwide. These services include inspection, analysis, sampling, and certification  of metals and minerals, including non-ferrous and ferrous ores and concentrates, minor metals, precious  and platinum group metals, ferro-alloys, recycled scrap metal, complex materials and plastics, fuels, agricultural and soft commodities and food products.
The company's inspection services include the supervision of cargo operations, quantity control, and quality verification.
Alex Stewart International employs approximately 600 staff members, operates 45 offices, and has 14 analytical laboratories in various countries worldwide.
History
K. Alexander Stewart (1934 - 2018) founded Alex Stewart International Group in 1978, leveraging his extensive experience in sampling and analysis. He was a an Associate and Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry (FRSC) and a member of the Institute of Materials, Minerals, and Mining (MIMM).
After moving beyond basic laboratory responsibilities, Stewart earned an honors degree in chemistry and became a member of the Royal Institute of Chemistry. With years of experience in the metallurgical industry, he played a pioneering role in developing modern analytical methods, particularly atomic absorption spectroscopy for gold and silver analysis.
Before founding his company, Stewart worked at Alfred H Knight, where he introduced full platinum group metal analysis using both atomic absorption and fire assay methods. In 1967, he became a director and expanded the business between 1967 and 1977. In 1977, he founded his own companies, Alex Stewart Assayers Ltd and AS Metallurgy Liverpool Ltd, establishing an inspection and laboratory business that became a major player in Knowsley, near Liverpool.
In 2004, Alex Stewart Agriculture  was established following the acquisition of A Norman Tate and Huson and Hardwick laboratories , enabling the company to provide services in the agricultural sector. In 2010, a specialized metal analysis laboratory, Alex Stewart International, became the core of the company's global inspection office network. In 2013, the company expanded its analytical capabilities by opening a new laboratory in Sefton Business Park near Liverpool, UK.
Throughout his career, Stewart traveled extensively, visiting 104 countries, many of which he entered with the intention of registering his company and establishing business operations. These included the USA, China, Ukraine, Malaysia, Rwanda, Mongolia, Kyrgyzstan, and India.
Operations
Alex Stewart International  provides inspection services (supervision, weighing, and sampling) and accredited analytical services for testing and analyzing metals in more than 40 countries. The company works with ferrous, non-ferrous, and precious metals, including jewelry, ores, concentrates, ferroalloys, recycled scrap, complex metallurgical materials, coal, and fertilizers. Through collaboration with Alex Stewart Agriculture, the company also provides analytical and environmental services for agricultural commodities. All of cargo supervision, inspection and sampling is carried out according to ISO and IFIA standards.
The Alex Stewart International laboratory network carries out GAFTA and FOSFA-approved analysis and issues certificates required for commercial transactions and is accredited by UKAS to ISO 17025 standards.
Management
*K. Alexander Stewart (1934–2018) – Founder
*Graham Stewart – CEO
Operations in Ukraine
In Ukraine, Alex Stewart International operates under ASi Ukraine, with its central office in Odesa and branches in major Ukrainian ports and Kyiv.
Founded in 2002, ASi Ukraine LLC provides inspection services at all stages of production and transportation, including sampling, quantity verification, and compliance with international standards. Each division of the company has its own team of surveyors, tallymen, and supervisors, along with the necessary equipment, vehicles, and communication tools. The company serves manufacturers, exporters, and importers.
Laboratory testing to verify compliance with contractual specifications and international standards is performed either at ASi Ukraine LLC's laboratory or within the Alex Stewart International laboratory network.
The company’s inspection and analytical services comply with international standards and are accredited by organizations such as FOSFA, GAFTA, and NAAU under ISO 17025 certification.
